github.description: GitHub Copilot MCP server for repository operations. Requires GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN (fine-grained PAT, least privilege) in your environment; if it is unset the header is sent empty and the server rejects it.

chrome-devtools.description: Chrome DevTools MCP — Lighthouse audits (mcp__chrome-devtools__lighthouse_audit), Core Web Vitals analysis, performance traces, CPU/network throttling. Use alongside playwright-cli: playwright-cli handles navigation/inspection, chrome-devtools handles perf analysis and Lighthouse scoring.

context7.description: Context7 MCP pulls up-to-date, version-specific documentation and code examples straight from the source — and places them directly into your prompt.

postgres.description: PostgreSQL MCP server for schema inspection and read-only queries. The package is archived upstream (no security fixes): point it at a local or dev database only, with a SELECT-only role, and keep the password out of POSTGRES_CONNECTION_STRING (libpq reads PGPASSWORD or ~/.pgpass), because the string is passed as an argument and is visible in the process list. For Cloud SQL use cloud-sql-postgres (read-only) instead.

docker.description: Docker MCP server for container and image management.

xcodebuild.description: Xcode build, run, debug, and test for iOS simulator, device, and macOS targets. Replaces ios-simulator MCP.

maestro.description: Maestro MCP server for cross-platform mobile E2E testing on iOS and Android.

adk-docs.description: Google Agent Development Kit documentation via mcpdoc.

voicemode.description: Voice Mode for Claude Code — OpenAI Whisper API (STT) + OpenAI TTS API (speech output). Local Whisper + Kokoro available on Apple Silicon.

stripe.description: Stripe MCP server (@stripe/mcp 0.3.4, stdio). The key is read from the STRIPE_SECRET_KEY env var, never passed as an argument (argv is visible in the process list). Tool scope is set by the key, not by flags: 0.3.4 ignores --tools (removed upstream), so use a Restricted API Key (rk_test_...) granting only the resources you need. Claude Code permissions allow only the read tools; stripe_api_write and send_stripe_feedback always ask. Stripe has deprecated this package (no further security fixes) in favour of the hosted server at https://mcp.stripe.com with OAuth: migrate when you can.

revenuecat.description: Official RevenueCat MCP server (project/app, products, entitlements, offerings). Authenticates with OAuth: run /mcp and sign in. No static API-key header, so no secret sits in this file or your shell.

firestore.description: Google-managed Firestore MCP server. Uses your Google Cloud credentials (gcloud auth application-default login); acts on whatever project those credentials can reach, so use a non-production project or a least-privilege account.

firebase-emulator.description: Firebase MCP pointed at the local Emulator Suite (default emulator ports). Start the emulators first (firebase emulators:start) and set FIREBASE_LOCAL_PROJECT_ID to a demo-* project id so nothing reaches a real project.

weaviate-local.description: Weaviate MCP endpoint of a local Weaviate instance (docker-compose). Local development only; never point it at a shared cluster without auth.

gcp-cloud-cli.description: Google-managed Cloud CLI MCP server. Uses your Google Cloud credentials; can change resources the account is allowed to change.

gcp-cloud-run.description: Google-managed Cloud Run MCP server (services, revisions, deploys). Uses your Google Cloud credentials.

gcp-logging.description: Google-managed Cloud Logging MCP server for querying logs. Uses your Google Cloud credentials; log entries can contain PII.

gcp-monitoring.description: Google-managed Cloud Monitoring MCP server (metrics, alerting). Uses your Google Cloud credentials.

gcp-iam.description: Google-managed IAM MCP server. Uses your Google Cloud credentials. IAM changes are security-sensitive: review every write before approving it.

gcp-pubsub.description: Google-managed Pub/Sub MCP server (topics, subscriptions). Uses your Google Cloud credentials.

cloud-sql-postgres.description: Google-managed Cloud SQL MCP server, read-only endpoint. Uses your Google Cloud credentials. Prefer it over cloud-sql-admin for inspection.

cloud-sql-admin.description: Google-managed Cloud SQL admin MCP server (instances, databases, users). Uses your Google Cloud credentials; write-capable, so review every change.

cloud-storage.description: Google-managed Cloud Storage MCP server (buckets, objects). Uses your Google Cloud credentials.

gcp-cloud-assist.description: Google-managed Gemini Cloud Assist MCP server (design and troubleshooting help). Uses your Google Cloud credentials.

terraform.description: HashiCorp Terraform MCP server (registry providers and modules docs) in Docker, image pinned to 1.4.1. Needs a running Docker daemon.

mobile-mcp.description: Mobile device automation (Android emulator / iOS simulator) for exploratory checks. Flutter Android/iOS UI and E2E tests still use Maestro only (.claude/rules/testing-tool-selection.md).

appstore-connect.description: App Store Connect MCP (apps, builds, TestFlight, reviews). Reads an API key from the .p8 file path in APP_STORE_CONNECT_P8_PATH (never inline the key). Writes are disabled (APP_STORE_CONNECT_ALLOW_WRITES=0); enable them only for a reviewed release task.

google-play-developer.description: Google Play Developer API MCP (tracks, releases, reviews). Uses a service-account credential configured outside this file; grant it the least Play Console permissions needed.
